---
title: Data analysis
description: dplyr and ggplot2 output rendered at build time.
---

```{r}
#| echo: false
set.seed(42)

df_data <- tibble::tibble(
  group = rep(c("A", "B", "C"), each = 50),
  value = c(rnorm(50, 0), rnorm(50, 1.5), rnorm(50, 3))
)
```

## Summary table

```{r}
#| label: tbl-summary
#| tbl-cap: "Summary statistics per group."
df_summary <- df_data |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    mean = mean(value),
    sd = sd(value),
    count = dplyr::n(),
    .by = group
  )

knitr::kable(df_summary, digits = 2)
```

@tbl-summary summarises the simulated data.

## Distribution

```{r}
#| label: fig-hist
#| fig-cap: "Histogram of values per group."
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 3.5
ggplot2::ggplot(df_data, ggplot2::aes(value, fill = group)) +
  ggplot2::geom_histogram(bins = 15, alpha = 0.6, position = "identity") +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal()
```

The groups in @fig-hist are clearly shifted.
